title: A project whose backlog.json names no item_dir keeps its item files in _backlog/ at the repository root
goal: SETTINGS' item_dir default is _backlog/ (per the gate on the default item directory): a project with no backlog.json, or one without item_dir, creates and reads its items in _backlog/ at its root, and a worker's git worktree can write there; the kb's own backlog.json already names kb/_self/backlog, so its items, and every setting the file names, are unchanged; the config doc and backlog.py config print the new default

gates.question: Which glob does always_in_scope's default hold for the item files, now that item_dir defaults to _backlog?
options: _backlog/** replaces kb/_self/backlog/** as the default's first glob (a project naming another item_dir names always_in_scope too)
the accessor adds <item_dir>/** to any always_in_scope, so the item files are always in scope whatever item_dir is
gates.recommendation: _backlog/** replaces kb/_self/backlog/** as the default's first glob (a project naming another item_dir names always_in_scope too)
gates.answer: _backlog/** replaces kb/_self/backlog/** as the default's first glob (a project naming another item_dir names always_in_scope too)

notes: Orchestrator: the suite is at the 100-id ceiling: plugin_sprint_item_dir_default extends or replaces an existing test, adding no id.
